summary: Carlos Sainz won the Mexico City Grand Prix from pole position, 4.7s ahead of Lando Norris, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Oscar Piastri made the biggest climb, from P17 to P8.
Liam Lawson had a day to forget, dropping from P12 to P16.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised PER (5 second time penalty), VER (10 second time penalty), VER (10 second time penalty) and COL (10 second time penalty).
There were 21 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 47 points over Lando Norris.
